author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Researchers found 36,769 exposed AI endpoints, but only 2% had an HTTP authentication gate. Running AI locally is supposed to give organizations more control. Models, prompts and documents stay on infrastructure they manage instead of being sent to a third-party cloud. But that advantage disappears quickly when the infrastructure itself is exposed to the public […]
title: The AI Supply Chain Has a Security Problem, and Much of It Is Sitting on the Open Internet

title: Attackers Exploit Critical Cisco FMC Flaw to deploy Qilin ransomware
